entities.summary: Amina Ivnievna Shafikova is a prominent state figure of the Republic of Bashkortostan, a pianist, educator, professor at the Ufa State Institute of Arts, and Minister of Culture of the Republic of Bashkortostan. She is an Honored Artist of the Republic of Bashkortostan (2002), People's Artist of the Republic of Bashkortostan (2024), and a laureate of state awards of Russia and Bashkortostan.
